tenderSchedule.title: CONTINUOUS AMBIENT AIR QUALITY MONITORING STATIONS
tenderSchedule.description: SUPPLY, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING OF 12 NOS CONTINUOUS AMBIENT AIR QUALITY MONITORING STATIONS, DISPLAY BOARD ANNUAL MAINTENANCE CONTRACT FOR CAAQMS UNDER KMERC PROJECT BY KSPCB

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board No 49 Parisara Bhavan 3rd Floor Board Meeting Hall Church Street BENGALURU 560001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment from participating in a Tender, and as on the last date of submission of Tenders.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Other terms and conditions are as per the tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the Tenderer is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) but not MSME, he should have manufactured, tested and supplied at least 80% of goods similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last 3 (three) completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-2024, 2022-2023,2021-2022). The goods offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after 2023 and be in satisfactory operation for 6 months as on date of Tender opening.

If the Tenderer is an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and an MSME, he should have manufactured, tested and supplied at least 50 percentage of goods similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last 3 (three) completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-2024, 2022-2023, 2021-22). The goods offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should have been released on or after 2023 and be in satisfactory operation for 6 months as on date of Tender opening.

Tenders of Tenderers quoting as authorized representative of a manufacturer,meeting with the above requirement in full, can also be considered provided a.the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format at Section XIII Tech Form 7 assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and b. the Tenderer, as authorized representative, has supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 30 percentage of quantity similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements in any one of the last three years which must be in satisfactory operation for at least 6 months on the date of Tender opening.
Group of single business entities (Consortium) is NOT allowed to participate in this Tender process.

A partnership firm or a limited liability partnership firm should submit copy of registration certificate, PAN and IT returns for the last 3 (three) financial years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (2024-2025 to 2022-2023).

Tenderer should submit the compliance statement for technical specification and scope of work for quoted items, and provide the technical brochure marked and highlighted points of the required technical specification as per Section VI of this document (highlighted scanned copy of brochure required)

The Tenderer shall provide documentation proving the successful supply and commissioning of Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring (CAAQM) stations to the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) or any State Pollution Control Board (SPCB) within the past 10 years.

a.Scanned copy of Registration under the applicable law for establishing their legal identity. b.Scanned copy of Registration under the Goods and Service Tax (GST) of the State.C.Scanned copy of Permanent Account Number (PAN) issued by the Board of Direct Taxes under the Income Tax Act, 1961.d.Scanned copy of Udyam Registration (online registration for MSME), if applicable.e.Scanned copy of ISO/ISI/BIS Certificate.

Tenderers contracts should not have been terminated during the last 3 (three) financial years i.e Financial Years of 2024-2025, 2023-2024, 2022-2023, due to non-fulfillment of contractual obligations as evidenced by imposition of a penalty by any procurement entity or by an arbitral or judicial authority or a judicial pronouncement or arbitration award against the Tenderer.

A company should furnish copy of the certificate of incorporation and memorandum of association, PAN and IT returns for the last 3 (three) financial years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders (2024-2025 to 2022-2023).

A proprietorship firm should furnish self-declaration or self-certificate supported by PAN in the proprietor name, PAN and IT returns for the last 3 (three) financial years preceding last date for submission of Tenders. (2024-2025 to 2022-2023).
Any other relevant document as deemed suitable maybe uploaded as per the tender document.
